heading: Key improvement
text:
### Key improvement [LNLS.7.2]

The dominant beta term in the general formula is O(L_β × T_j) or
O(R_α × T_j), both O(N_max) worst case.

Under `linear_scan: false`, J_max = 1 is **statically proven** by the compiler,
not assumed or approximated.  Every join is a single hash probe with
at most one candidate — no loop, no scan, no iteration.  Beta
operations are **unconditionally O(1) per fact assert or retract**,
independent of N_max and any deployment parameter.

The beta terms drop from O(N_max × T_j) to O(1).  For N_max = 100,000
this eliminates the dominant term from T_wcet entirely.
